decided: orbit writes a change's account only into the change's own account folder, and refuses when that folder is a link to somewhere else, inside or outside the change's trail, checking both when the folder is made and again just before writing.
alternatives: write to the folder's path as given, following any link
why: The decision records' folder already has this protection; without it the account folder would be the one place a link could send orbit's writes outside the change's trail.

relies_on.title: Engine-owned spine composition and filename discipline

defines.definition: a change's plain-language record of what it built, each new place the user is asked something or where a setting now changes what happens, and where the work left its stage's charter
the folder in a change's trail that holds the change's account
